name: Ann Walker

bio.statement: Ballotpedia lists Ann Walker, a Republican, as a candidate for Oregon House District 49 in 2026.
bio.excerpt: Ann Walker (Republican Party) is running for election to the Oregon House of Representatives to represent District 49.

verification.note: Re-fetched 2026-10-16; excerpt present verbatim; attribution, tier and wording checked.

bio.statement: Walker's pamphlet statement lists the occupation as owner of Ann Walker Consulting, LLC and wildfire consultant for 14 years, with a background including Western Governors' Association fire and forestry policy director for 8 years.
bio.excerpt: Occupation: Small Business Owner, Ann Walker Consulting, LLC, Wildfire Consultant 14 years Occupational Background: Western Governors' Assn(WGA), Fire and Forestry Policy Director 8 years

source.publisher: Oregon Secretary of State, Voters' Pamphlet (Multnomah County edition), p. 56

verification.note: Excerpt found verbatim in the candidate's own column of the SOS voters' pamphlet extract (page 56); attribution, tier and wording checked.

bio.statement: Walker's pamphlet statement lists wildland fire and incident management training, forest law courses, a forest fire risk restoration course and Molalla Union High School as the educational background.
bio.excerpt: Educational Background: FEMA Cert 700 National Incident Management; ODF S-110 Wildland Fire Suppression; S-130 Firefighter Training; S-190 Fire Behavior; S-290 Intermediate Wildland Fire Behavior; D-510 Supervisory Dispatcher; Forest Law I & II; OFRI-Forest Fire Risk Restoration; Molalla Union High School.

source.publisher: Oregon Secretary of State, Voters' Pamphlet (Multnomah County edition), p. 56

verification.note: Excerpt was cut before 'Molalla Union High School' which the statement mentions; extended to the full printed line (<=50 words) and statement adjusted.
